[SWS_CM_10494] Remote Access Control Activation
Upstream requirements:
RS_AP_00158
⌈
If
CmModuleInstantiation
.
remoteAccessControlEnabled
is defined and is
set to false,
CM
shall perform no remote access control, i.e., no access to any ser-
vice from a remote subject shall be restricted because of missing
ComGrant
s. If
Cm-
ModuleInstantiation
.
remoteAccessControlEnabled
is not defined or is set
to true,
CM
shall perform remote access control.
⌋
7.3.1.2 Local Access Control
